## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm e2e`, or an explanation of why browser tests do not apply

## Public-data and rights review

- [ ] I ran `pnpm audit:public`.
- [ ] This change contains no credentials, personal contact information, private endpoints, raw user
      audio, machine-specific paths, or real user data.
- [ ] Test data, screenshots, and examples use synthetic identifiers and reserved example domains.
- [ ] Added music, lyrics, MIDI, tablature, recordings, artwork, and video have documented rights and
      attribution, or this change adds none.
- [ ] Browser microphone and WebMCP privacy boundaries remain intact, or the privacy impact is
      explained below.

## Privacy or rights notes

Write `None` when the change does not affect either area.
